intent_en: To illustrate the significant prevalence of fracking in new oil and gas well drilling.
previous_intent: To illustrate that fracking is used for the majority of new oil and gas wells.
narration_support: Over 60 % of all new oil and gas wells are drilled by using fracking.
chart_support: Donut chart displaying a 60% orange segment and a blue segment, flanked by an oil drop icon and a textured circle icon representing fracking.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly states the percentage and method, while the chart visualizes this proportion with a donut chart and relevant icons (oil drop and fracking texture).
